question: What is the meaning of conditions for use of hardware needed in relation to ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing and refurbishment?
data_group: ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing and refurbishment
data_point: conditions for use of hardware needed
description:
The conditions for use of hardware needed in relation to ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing, and refurbishment refer to the specifications and requirements that ensure hardware components can be easily upgraded, reused, remanufactured, and refurbished. This includes compatibility with commonly available spare parts, ease of maintenance and refurbishment, and the ability to separate and recover different materials or substances during dismantling or recycling procedures. These conditions aim to extend the useful life of products, minimize waste generation, and promote sustainable sourcing and resource efficiency. They also help in reducing the packaging/product ratio and minimizing the generation of hazardous waste. <|ENDINPUT>
